HEV Socks5 Tunnel
Source: https://github.com/heiher/hev-socks5-tunnel
Commit: 64cc609f945253b0e9ebc56317d544268f3c68c1
License: MIT (see hev-socks5-tunnel.LICENSE)

The checked-in Android shared libraries were built without functional source
modifications for armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, and x86_64.

The HEV build statically links its hev-socks5-core, hev-task-system, libyaml
fork, and lwIP dependencies. The HEV components and libyaml fork use the same
MIT license text included in hev-socks5-tunnel.LICENSE. lwIP is distributed
under its BSD license included in lwip.LICENSE.
